{{Quote|This is Unit 6 in Barracks D4. We have severe structural damage here.|A stormtrooper talking about Barracks D4|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
'''Barracks D4''' was a barracks which had been built by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] in [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="TFUII" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUIIComic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] late [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Galen Marek]], [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escaped]] the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="TFUII" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II}}
During the escape, Barracks D4 was mentioned by [[Unit 6]]. According to a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], it had sustained severe structural damage after Vader forced an elevator shaft down into it.<ref name="TFUII" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Barracks D4 was first mentioned in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]]. During each playthrough, the quote is randomized, meaning the stormtrooper may or may not report the damage to Barracks D4.<ref name="TFUII" />
